newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore stocks flat, shrug off production data.
newsitem.headline: Singapore stocks flat, shrug off production data.

text.p: The Singapore stock market was expected to trade sideways on Tuesday, with little impact from April manufacturing output data released late on Monday, dealers said.
Singapore's Economic Development Board reported April manufacturing output rose 1.1 percent from a year earlier, after falling a revised 6.9 percent in March.
Dealers said the rise was in line with expectations after the April non-oil domestic exports, released by the Trade Development Board on May 20, showed a 5.9 percent year-on-year increase.
The Straits Times Industrials Index ended 2.09 points down at 2,030.21 on Monday. Wall Street extended gains by 42.72 points to 7,478.50.
